title: Our tour guide Xavier...
text: Our tour guide Xavier took us on an excellent walking and auto tour of Barcelona. He was extremely knowledgeable and informative. He paced the walking portion as slow or rapid as needed. Scheduled rest breaks appropriately.  One of the best guides on my vacation.
author: Joseph_C

title: Well organised, informative and great guide Isabel
text: Isabel was fantastic, lots of great information and was fun to spend the day with. The tour was organised, mixture of walking and driving. Vey helpful and informative ⭐️
author: Sascha S

title: Amazing tour!!
text: We did guided tours all over Europe Xabi made this one the best. We highly recommend this tour and make sure you request Xabi, he’s the best!
author: Eduardo_D

title: Private tour of Barcelona
text: La Sagrada Familia was amazing, as was Park Guell. The guide was very professional, experienced, and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend this tour.
author: Jeremy_B

title: Comprehensive tour of Barcelona
text: Barcelona was a lovely city to see and this tour did it justice.  We were met by Miguel right outside the cruise terminal.  We initially toured the beautiful Gothic quarter and enjoyed a lovely pastry and coffee to keep us going.  It was an excellent overview of the city center and it's heritage.  We then went to the Sagrada Familia and it was amazing to not have to wait the the LONG lines outside as our tickets were included. We spent over an hour there and it was time well spent. author: Amy_S

title: Worth every penny ! Perfect !!!
text:
My sister and I had wonderful experience with this private 8 hour tour. Our guide Nuirna (hope we spelled correctly) :) 
Was so informative and thoughtful to our individual pace and preferences. 
We loved our time with our guide learned so much about the culture history and beautiful sites! 
So much fun and worth every penny !
Thank you for making our stay in Barcelona so enjoyable !
Allyson and sister Sandee :)
author: allyson_b

title: Barcelona at its best
text: Our tour was fantastic.   Ana was a great tour guide with enthusiasm and detailed knowledge of each stop along the way.   Loved every minute of our day !
author: Stephen_W

title: Barcelona private tour
text: Nuria was an excellent guide, knowledgeable and extremely helpful. Ivan, our driver was also great, right on time and got us exactly where we needed to go.
author: Cecile W

title: Great tour
text: Miguel did a great job . Was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. He was very accommodating of what we wanted to see and our schedule .  I would highly recommend him and our driver Vicente .
author: Greg_S

title: Best of Barcelona!
text: Such a wonderful day filled with the very best of Barcelona.  Our guide, Montse Marques, was truly fantastic.  She was knowledgeable, friendly, and answered all our assorted questions along the way.  I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to have an exclusive tour of the city’s highlights in their own private group.
author: Lyn G
